references.text: Moses uses the same encouragement to Joshua and Israel: 'Be strong and courageous, do not fear or be afraid of them', which Joshua now repeats to the people.
The Lord goes before you; he will be with you; he will not fail you or forsake you. Do not fear or lose heart.
The same exhortation not to fear, for the Lord will fight for them against their enemies.
The Lord's original command to Joshua to be strong and courageous, which Joshua now passes on to the people.
The Lord commanded Joshua to be strong and courageous, not to fear or lose heart, because the Lord is with him.
The Lord says to Joshua before the battle at Ai: 'Do not fear or lose heart', the same exhortation that Joshua gives here.
The Lord repeats the encouragement to Joshua: 'Do not be afraid of them', before the battle at Merom.
Do not fear, for I am with you. Do not be afraid, for I am your God. The same encouragement about God's presence against fear.
Encouragement not to fear the people in the land, because the Lord is with Israel.
David tells Saul that no one should lose heart because of the Philistine, the same encouragement against fear of enemies.
